title: Mixture of Many Zero-Compute Experts: A High-Rate Quantization Theory Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2510.03151v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper uses classical high-rate quantization theory to provide new insights into mixture-of-experts (MoE) models for regression tasks. Our MoE is defined by a segmentation of the input space to regions, each with a single-parameter expert that acts as a constant predictor with zero-compute at inference. Motivated by high-rate quantization theory assumptions, we assume that the number of experts is sufficiently large to make their input-space regions very small. This lets us study the approximation error of our MoE model class: (i) for one-dimensional inputs, we formulate the test error and its minimizing segmentation and experts; (ii) for multidimensional inputs, we formulate an upper bound for the test error and study its minimization. translated_title: 大量零计算专家的混合：高率量化理论的视角
translated_abstract: 本文利用经典的高率量化理论，为回归任务中的专家混合模型提供了新的见解。我们的MoE模型通过将输入空间分割为多个区域来定义，每个区域由一个单参数专家负责，该专家在推理时充当零计算的常数预测器。受高率量化理论假设的启发，我们假设专家的数量足够多，使得它们对应的输入空间区域非常小。这使我们能够研究该MoE模型类的逼近误差：(i) 对于一维输入，我们给出了测试误差的公式及其最小化所需的分割方式与专家；(ii) 对于多维输入，我们给出了测试误差的上界并研究其最小化问题。此外，我们考虑在给定输入空间分割的情况下，从训练数据集中学习专家参数，并阐述了其统计学习特性。这使我们得出定理……
tldr: 本文借助高率量化理论，分析了一种由推理时零计算的单参数常数专家构成的MoE模型，推导了其在一维与多维输入下的测试误差逼近结果以及专家参数的统计学习性质。
en_tdlr: This paper leverages high-rate quantization theory to analyze a MoE model composed of zero-compute single-parameter constant experts, deriving test error approximation results for one-dimensional and multidimensional inputs along with the statistical learning properties of the expert parameters.
